IDList.description: Omitted KB list means permitted KBs; an explicit empty list means no KBs, never unrestricted access

reflection.description: May disable reflection; enabling is subject to server policy

Locator.description: Character ranges are Unicode codepoint half-open ranges; semantic validation requires end >= start and bounds within canonical content. Coarse positioning is explicit.

Timings.description: Stage names mapped to milliseconds; no content or secret values

BoundingBox.description: [left, top, right, bottom], normalized to a page in its canonical displayed orientation. Semantic checks require left < right and top < bottom.

BlobRef.description: Logical reference; never a physical path or unauthenticated public URL

formula.description: Preserved source formula; platform clients must not execute it

number_text.description: Optional exact numeric representation, preserving precision; not binary float

TableContent.description: Sparse cells allowed; absent means unknown, explicit empty text means known empty. Cells must be in bounds and merged rectangles must not overlap.

AudioSegment.description: Half-open milliseconds; validate start <= end <= duration. Speaker labels are annotations, not identities.
